notes.title: ElectricVLab Update 1.5.0 Released
notes.notes:
Added 74126 Quad Tri-State Buffer to the collection of components.
 Added a new sample circuit illustrating the use of tri-state buffers in implementing a multiplexer. It can be found in the Digital Cicuits-1/Multiplexers & Demultiplexers folder.
 Supporting parallel connection of batteries.

notes.title: New Version (1.3.4) of ElectricVLab Released
notes.notes:
A new version (1.3.4) of ElectricVLab has been released.

Main updates in this version are:

 Highlighting invalid part of a circuit. Earlier, if the circuit created by the user happens to be invalid (e.g., a battery is shorted), only an error message saying "Invalid Circuit" was getting displayed. Now, in addition to displaying the error message, the part of the circuit that happens to be invalid gets highlighted to make it easier to identify the error.
 Added ability to change the color of multiple wires simultaneously. While using object tool, in the pop-up menu that comes up after dragging a rectangular region, a new option titled "Set wire color" is now available.
 During simulation, one can now change the resistance of rheostat by holding down the left mouse button and dragging the scroller handle. Earlier, the resistance value of rheostat could be changed only by bringing up the parameter dialog. The newly added way allows the resistance to be changed during simulation in a more natural and convenient way.
 Improved support for high resolution monitors.
